/// MQ4-G256-SEL (qt=43) codebook family, 16 profiles x 16 levels.
/// Values are in MAX-NORMALISED space: the block scale field stores the block's
/// max |coefficient|, so level 15 == +1.0 maps EXACTLY onto that maximum and the
/// dominant coefficient of every block is representable with zero clipping error.
/// Designed by generalized Lloyd over the family (alternating block->profile
/// assignment and per-profile constrained refit, outermost pinned at +/-1.0) on

/// relative error 0.000% vs 10.859%.
